_note: Reading by a model (the agent that built the detector, revised after an independent review), by library notion, with overrides per project definition. Not evidence of mathematical quality; the kernel-checked statements are the evidence. R = the project definition rebuilds the library notion by writing out its definition; I = a true equality, but the library notion is a general combinator and the project definition names one specific object built with it; C = coincidence: the library definition unfolds to a small formula or pair encoding that the project term equals definitionally, with no shared meaning. A fourth label, U (use of the library), is not a reading: report.py assigns it mechanically to every alias-rule pair, where the project definition is the library constant applied to its own parameters.
